Release 7.12
============

The new Page Rollup layout shows more information on each card and loads faster.

- Smart properties fill in document metadata automatically.
- Editors can preview a template in each language before they publish it.
- Administrators can choose which page types are included in search.
- The log file will be available for 14 days, and new headings will be added to the navigation automatically.

Code samples are not checked for tone:

.. code-block:: text

   TODO: this placeholder is part of a sample configuration

A sentence that must stay as it is can be wrapped in vale off and on comments:

.. vale off

The phrase "key selling point" is quoted here on purpose.

.. vale on

One rule can be turned off for a passage:

.. vale Omnia.FuturePromises = NO

The connector will be available in a future release.

.. vale Omnia.FuturePromises = YES
